# QuickAccounts by Dotcode Solutions
> Wholesale inventory, serial-number, warranty, RMA, and accounting software for distributors and stock-led businesses.

## Product
- [QuickAccounts overview](https://dotcodesolutions.com/): Product capabilities, company information, pricing summary, and implementation support
- [Pricing](https://dotcodesolutions.com/pricing): Offline and online lifetime-license options and hosting costs
- [Implementation](https://dotcodesolutions.com/implementation): Setup, supported migration, and team training
- [Custom ERP development](https://dotcodesolutions.com/custom-erp-development): Custom accounting, sales, purchasing, team, outlet, and workflow software

## Core workflows
- [Wholesale inventory](https://dotcodesolutions.com/solutions/wholesale-inventory): Stock, purchasing, sales, customer accounts, cash, and ledgers
- [Serial-number tracking](https://dotcodesolutions.com/features/serial-number-tracking): Unit-level traceability and invoice lookup
- [Warranty management](https://dotcodesolutions.com/features/warranty-management): Warranty claims, RMAs, returns, and replacements
- [Multi-warehouse inventory](https://dotcodesolutions.com/features/multi-warehouse-inventory): Stock visibility and transfers across locations
- [Business accounting](https://dotcodesolutions.com/features/business-accounting): Customer, supplier, cash, and ledger records
- [POS system integration](https://dotcodesolutions.com/features/pos-system-integration): Counter sales synced with stock, serials, and accounts

## Industries
- [Industries overview](https://dotcodesolutions.com/industries): Workflow pages for distribution and stock-led retail trades
- [FMCG wholesalers and distributors](https://dotcodesolutions.com/industries/fmcg-wholesalers-distributors): High-volume stock, supplier purchasing, and retailer account balances
- [Clothing and garment retailers/wholesalers](https://dotcodesolutions.com/industries/clothing-garment-retailers-wholesalers): Garment catalogue, shop and warehouse stock, retail and trade sales
- [Cosmetics and beauty product distributors](https://dotcodesolutions.com/industries/cosmetics-beauty-distributors): Broad catalogue, salon and retailer accounts, returns
- [Automotive and motorcycle spare-parts dealers](https://dotcodesolutions.com/industries/automotive-motorcycle-spare-parts): Part lookup, counter sales, workshop accounts
- [Grocery stores and supermarkets](https://dotcodesolutions.com/industries/grocery-stores-supermarkets): Counter sales synced with stock and purchasing
- [Building materials, tiles, and sanitary ware dealers](https://dotcodesolutions.com/industries/building-materials-tiles-sanitary-ware): Bulk stock, supplier purchasing, contractor accounts
- [Pharmaceutical and medical supply distributors](https://dotcodesolutions.com/industries/pharmaceutical-medical-supply): Organized purchasing, stock, invoicing, and account records
- [Footwear and leather goods retailers](https://dotcodesolutions.com/industries/footwear-leather-goods): Shop and warehouse stock with invoice-linked exchanges
- [Furniture and home furnishing businesses](https://dotcodesolutions.com/industries/furniture-home-furnishing): Showroom and warehouse stock, high-value sales history
- [Food and restaurant supply wholesalers](https://dotcodesolutions.com/industries/food-restaurant-supply): Repeat wholesale orders and customer balances
- [Stationery and school supply distributors](https://dotcodesolutions.com/industries/stationery-school-supply): Seasonal buying and institutional accounts
- [Agricultural supply distributors](https://dotcodesolutions.com/industries/agricultural-supply): Seasonal stock and dealer accounts across warehouses
- [Electronics distributors](https://dotcodesolutions.com/industries/electronics-distributors): Serial traceability and after-sales workflows
- [Computer hardware wholesalers](https://dotcodesolutions.com/industries/computer-hardware-wholesalers): Hardware stock, sales records, and warranty inquiries
- [Multi-outlet retailers](https://dotcodesolutions.com/industries/multi-outlet-retailers): Product records and accounts across retail branches
- [General merchandise wholesalers](https://dotcodesolutions.com/industries/merchandise-wholesalers): Purchasing, stock, and customer ledgers in one workflow
